description.title: How to get the MMEL updated?

descbody.para: Airbus provides the Operator with an MMEL which reflects the aircraft configuration at delivery, and the necessary revisions to reflect configuration changes due to Airbus approved modifications.

The Operator must inform Airbus without delay of the effective changes to the aircraft delivery configuration made through Airbus Service Bulletin (SB). This permits Airbus to provide the Operator with the MMEL revisions/updates.
The Operator must timely report any SB embodiment to the following address:

unlist.para: Airbus will not provide revisions, and will not take responsibility for any effect on the MMEL:

item.para: Due to modifications installed by third parties without an Airbus SB, and/or
Due to modifications installed through an Airbus SB, if Airbus is not informed of the SB embodiment.
